evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows', modifies CMake build configuration and CI scripts to switch native Windows builds from MSVC cl.exe to clang-cl.
rationale: Migrating native Windows builds to clang-cl resolves persistent compiler bugs and internal compiler errors (#31456, #36153) while cutting CI build times from 20m 35s to 12m 43s. It also removes recurring friction with MSVC constexpr limitations and enables future inline assembly support on Windows.
